title: Accordion header
brief: An open accordion item: a full-width header button with a title and a round chevron badge pointing up, followed by the answer text. The header tints on hover and shows an inset ring on focus.

inspiration.note: Took the header trigger with a rotated chevron when open; ours puts the chevron in a tinted round badge and shows the open panel.
Took the full-width header row with a hover fill; the terracotta palette, card shape and inset focus ring are ours.
